title: WHY THEY HATED US: WALKING IN THE FOOTSTEPS OF THE PERSECUTED

sense.text:
Our people keep asking, Why do they hate us? We never did nothing to them. The answer is easy, and the ones who struggle with it struggle because they are not in the truth. Christians cannot answer it; they say not all of them hate us. The answer is this: they were created to hate us. White people and all the other nations were created to hate the Israelite, and the Bible proves it from Genesis, the beginning.

“And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” Cain has the spirit of the white man, and Abel has the spirit of the black man. Cain represents Esau, and Abel represents Jacob. That is what this verse is talking about, for those Christians who think they know the Bible: Cain rose up against his brother and slew him.

precepts.why:
Go back one chapter and see where that killing comes from. God says, “And I will put enmity between thee and the woman”. Christians read right over that word. Enmity, in the dictionary, is positive, active and typically mutual hatred: deep hatred. This is God talking: I will put hatred between thee and the woman.

The serpent represents Esau, and the woman represents Jacob, the Israelite. God said he would put deep hatred between the white man and the black man. White people will never love black people; that is how God set it up. Some of you think you can change them. You cannot.

It is their nature. A lion's nature is to have no fear; it doesn't matter if you are bigger or smaller than him, even if he knows you are going to kill him, he will not fear you. A snake, poison or not, will eventually bite you. The white man's nature is to hate the black man; that is how God created it. You can marry them and have kids by them, and you cannot change their nature.

But we have to be real: Negro, you hate yourself too. Some of us hate each other more than the white man hates us; you see it in the news every day. A sister on social media said the world doesn't respect black people because our crimes are only against each other. America dropped two bombs on Japan, one on Hiroshima and one on Nagasaki, and today the Japanese still love white people and hate black people's guts, and we never dropped a bomb on nobody. A white man went into a Walmart in Buffalo, New York and started killing black people; black people never went into a white neighborhood and did that. Yet we are the most hated.

sense.text:
For every action there is a reaction. We were rebellious against God's laws before we even left Egypt, and today is no different. There is nothing new under the sun: the rebellious spirits of back then are still in the earth today.

We had just come out of Egypt and only just touched the wilderness; we had not gone to the promised land yet. We were the same people who saw God use Moses to split the Red Sea right in front of us. Moses said, I'll be right back, and “the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us”.

Aaron told them to “Break off the golden earrings”, and he “fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.”

They forgot the God that brought them out of Egypt and said this golden calf is the god that brought us out. That is how rebellious we are.

“And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)” Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, “Who is on the Lord’s side? let him come unto me.” And all the sons of Levi gathered unto him.

“Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.” Pick up your sword.

“And there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.” We had just left Egypt and had not been to the promised land yet, and right there three thousand of us dropped dead, killed because of rebellion. You are asking why they hate us; look first at what we did.

“All those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness”. We saw his glory: we saw the sea split, we saw the light he gave us by night, we saw what God can do. We saw all the plagues when Moses went in front of Pharaoh.

And yet they “have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice”. In the wilderness we had already tested God ten times.

“Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers”. “But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land”.

Out of all the people that came out of Egypt, only Caleb and Joshua saw that land. Their children saw it, but the Most High God killed all of the men that came out. That is how rebellious we were, and that is how rebellious we still are.

They told Moses, “hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness?” and “it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.” It was better for us to stay in Egypt.

Some of our people think that right now, because America is the spiritual Egypt today. You think all of our people want to leave this place? You think all of our people want to see it destroyed? You are crazy if you think that. Some of our people want this to go on forever. The same spirit that was back then has come back today.

They were slaves in Egypt, and they said it was better to stay in Egypt. It is the same thing today: we are slaves here in America, and we built this country.
“And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?” Now they were complaining about water.

Moses went to the Lord and cried out, and “the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them”.

“If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God”, and keep all his statutes, “I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians”. He is talking about the curses: when Pharaoh would not let us go, the Most High God put a lot of curses on the Egyptians, and God said they would not come on us if we kept the law.

But we weren't listening. We didn't care. We complained about everything.
“And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord”, and the fire of the Lord burnt among them and consumed them in the uttermost parts of the camp, and the place was called Taberah.
“Who shall give us flesh to eat?” Keep in mind, so far in the wilderness they had not gone hungry. The Most High God fed them manna and provided water, and they went and complained again.

“We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick”. They were saying, in Egypt we was eating good. “But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.”

You can't make this stuff up. Somebody will say, Deacon, if I was there I would never complain. Oh yes, you would. You would do exactly the same thing.

When we were in Egypt, were we loved by the Egyptians? No. The same way we are hated in America, we were hated in Egypt. Yet they said it was better to have stayed in Egypt, and they remembered the fish and the cucumbers. We were eating good, but we were not loved.

Some of us have it good here; America has spoiled some of us. Some of you never go anywhere, never even leave the state you were born in, because you love it here. It was the same in Egypt: some of us there had it good, like the taskmasters. Look at the so-called black leaders and black politicians today, some in the Congress and the Senate for over thirty years who never did one thing for the black community. Pastors living in ten and twenty million dollar houses, Creflo Dollar flying in a sixty-five million dollar private jet: you think they want America to fall? Hell no. We were hated in Egypt, and some of us still said, I want to go back.

“Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!”

“Were it not better for us to return into Egypt?” That is going to happen again. When Christ brings us back into the wilderness, some of us are going to say the same thing: I remember Burger King, there's no Burger King here; I remember the Big Macs. It's better for us to return to America.

It is not far-fetched. Every year at the Feast of Tabernacles you hear the complaints: I don't like where my tent spot is, I don't like this and that. Some bring an AC for the tent, a flat-screen TV, video games out to the wilderness. The Lord hears your murmuring in your tents.

“Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.” Basically they said, let's get rid of Moses, raise up another leader and go back to Egypt. God brought ten plagues on the Egyptians for Pharaoh to let us go, and they said, we don't give a damn about that, let's go back to Egypt. That is how rebellious we are as a people, and yet we are complaining about why they hate us.

“The people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.” Now we started committing whoredom with the Moabite, which is the so-called Chinese today. The people ate and “bowed down to their gods”, and Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor, and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.

The Lord told Moses to hang up the heads of the people before the Lord, and Moses told the judges, “Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor.” Moses was telling them, kill all the men that were sleeping with the Moabite women.

And here comes one of the children of Israel bringing “a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation”. No fear. Think about it: the Most High God is passing judgment, we are dying, and he doesn't care. All he cares about is getting his rod on, fulfilling his lust.

Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, “took a javelin in his hand”, went after the man into the tent, “and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly.” He killed both of them.
“And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.” God killed twenty-four thousand in one day. But that wasn't enough.

Judges is talking about the civil war: we had a civil war in Israel. The history: in Judges 19, Benjamin took a man's wife and abused her all night until she died, and the man sent pieces of her to the rest of the tribes to show what Benjamin did. All the tribes rose up against Benjamin. Benjamin took down Judah first, but eventually they overcame Benjamin.

“But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.”

precepts.why:
“And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them. And the Lord smote Benjamin before Israel”.

God smote Benjamin, and “the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men”. Twenty-five thousand of us died that day in that civil war.

sense.text:
“And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten”, “and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.” That day, when the Philistines came against us, thirty thousand Israelites fell.

Keep in mind: every time you see this judgment, it is because of sin. God allowed those numbers to die like that because we decided to turn our back on the Most High God, just like you see today. Nothing new under the sun.

precepts.why:
What the Lord has shown is that some Negroes ain't never going to get right. Everything he did, everything he showed them, they still wanted to sin. It is the same today: the word is going out, it makes perfect sense to black people, and they just don't want to do it.

“Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.” They were dropping by the tens of thousands. The sin that is within can't be purged out of them through mercy, through great miracles, or through the word of God. Some Negroes just got to die.

The same way God used that nation back then to put us to death, to correct us because we were evil, is the same thing today.

sense.text: “And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people.” David said, “I have sinned greatly in that I have done”. To number the people is what they call today a census.
“So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel”, “and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men.” God killed seventy thousand, because David decided to number the people.

A Christian on social media understands the hatred, looks right at it, and then says, but not all of them. That is not what the Bible says.

Edom, Esau, is the so-called white man today: the European, the British, the whole Caucasian race. White people today are the sons of Esau. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”. Wherever you see evil and wickedness, the white man is right there. You might not see him physically, but he is behind it. What you see going on all over the continent of Africa, in Haiti, in Jamaica, in Sudan, in the Congos: the white man is behind it. They might not be physically there, but they are in the background, the ones who finance it.

“And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Christians say some of them are good, some of them can repent, God changed his mind. The Bible says the people: all of them. God hates them forever. You cannot pray for them or beg God to receive them. God does not hear your prayer to save America; this place will go down.

precepts.why:
Christians, and black people in this country, say God can change, you have to evolve. God does not evolve. “For I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.”

The reason the Israelites are still alive is that God does not change. If he changed, he would have killed all of us. Black people, the Israelites, are still in this earth because God does not change: the same God yesterday, today and forever.

The same God who chose Israel to be his people is the same God today. He did not change and say, I'm going to pick a couple of white people, a couple of Chinese people. That is not in the Bible. So when Christians say God changed his mind, that some of them are good and can be received, the Bible answers: I change not.

sense.text:
Our job as Israelites is to help our people understand why this is happening to us. They are asking the question, and they do not have the answer; the answer is in the scriptures, not in anybody's opinion. We are the most hated people on the whole planet, and it is not only white people who hate us.

“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.” God has been silent for over four hundred years. They did evil after evil after evil to us, and God let them. But now the spirit of God is back on the earth, the Israelites are getting wise, and the nations are afraid, because they know what they did to us.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” No Christian church, no pastor, is teaching that God must bring judgment on this nation for the evil done to black people. The Israelites are the only ones teaching it. We are calling for the destruction of every nation that had its hand in our slavery and in destroying us, and it will happen.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” Taking crafty counsel is coming together. Ghana brought a resolution to the United Nations to recognize the enslavement of Africans as the gravest crime against humanity. It was adopted with 123 votes in favor and three against: the United States, Israel and Argentina. All Esau; the majority in Argentina is Esau, Amalek. Fifty-two countries abstained, including the United Kingdom and the European Union member states: all Esau. Silence is consent.

That is them holding themselves not guilty. They will never say, it is the greatest crime against humanity, and I did it. So you wanted to know how much they hate you; they keep showing you.

“Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” Today nobody knows who the Israelites are. They think the white people over there, Amalek, are the Israelites. No, we are the Israelites.

“For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee”. It is not a coincidence that everybody feels the same way about black people. No matter what country you travel to, they all feel the same thing about us. It is a spiritual thing: with one consent, they all have the same mindset. Confederate means they all agree, and that is what you see in the UN.

“The tabernacles of Edom” come first, and that is no coincidence: Edom is the head snake, number one. The Trump administration found 1.776 billion dollars to pay the January 6th insurrectionists, the people who went there and did it, while black Americans never got reparations for slavery, Jim Crow, stolen labor, redlining or Black Wall Street burned to the ground; under the DC Compensated Emancipation Act it was the slave owners who got paid. Trump sued the IRS for ten billion dollars and settled for almost two billion with nothing he ever did to be held against him. They create laws so they can hold themselves not guilty, and they show you every chance they get how much they hate your guts. Stop following the ways of Esau and listen to the word of God.

Then “the Ishmaelites”, the Arab; “Moab”, the so-called Chinese; “the Hagarenes”, the so-called Egyptian, the Hamite; then “Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek”, the people in the land being dealt with right now. It is describing the nations. Those are the nations that hate us, and they come together.

precepts.why:
The issue is that we look for equality from the wrong people. Instead of begging our enemy for reparations, we have to wait on the Lord to give us that equality.

“But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little, thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation”. That is what the Lord did in Egypt with the ten plagues: judgment little by little, the plague of darkness, the killing of the firstborn. But he knew they were a naughty generation, just like Esau today. They are not going to repent for the evil they have done to us.

“And that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.” They were made to hate us; their malice, their hatred, was bred in them. No matter what you do, bribe them, serve them, say thank you Mr. White man, the thoughts in their mind and the way they feel about you will never change. “For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon”. The Lord never forgave them. It is just a matter of time before the Lord gets his getback.

“For who shall say, What hast thou done? or who shall withstand thy judgment?” Who is going to fight against the Lord's judgment, or “come to stand against thee, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?” Nobody. “Neither shall king or tyrant be able to set his face against thee”: no president, no prime minister, no government official will be able to speak against his judgment, because it will be just.

“For when men will not believe that thou art of a full power, thou shewest thy strength”. Some do not believe the Lord is on our side right now, because he has been patient. “But thou, mastering thy power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour: for thou mayest use power when thou wilt.” When the Lord brings the judgment it is going to be equal: for all the evil they have done to us, they will get destruction. That is the vengeance of the Lord, and that is real equality. He orders his people with great favor, and we will get equality for the first time ever.

“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God”. Holy means separate: we are a separate people. “The Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.”

There is no equality with God. We were chosen to be above all nations. Not above the white man only, not above the Chinese only: above all people, all nations. And you wonder why they hate you? Why would they love you? They know something about you that you do not know: they know you are superior to them. Of course they are going to hate you.

Those nations in the psalm come together and hate us, and this is why. All the nations we just read about, we are separate from them. We are not the same as the other nations; there is a special spirit in us that they do not have. Stop asking the stupid question of why they hate us. They were created to hate you.

Amos said the same thing. “Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel”. God spoke against us because we sin, and today we continue to break his law.

“Against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt”. God did not bring any other families out of Egypt; the Israelite was the only one. So when did God start loving all the nations? All of a sudden Christ came and died for all these nations? That makes no sense.

“You only have I known of all the families of the earth”. Not the white man also, not the Chinese man also, not the Arab man also. Only means only. Out of all the nations on the planet, the Israelite is the only one God knows. That is why they hate you.

“Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” That judgment is what we are going through right now, because of our sin: a father punishing his children for breaking his law. It is time we get our mind right.

And before you ask why they hate you, ask why we hate ourselves. Forty percent of the abortions in this country are performed on black women, when we are supposed to be thirteen percent; twenty million black babies aborted since 1973, and that is only the southern kingdom. With all your education, it never told you to stop murdering your children. The woman who started Planned Parenthood, Margaret Sanger, was a eugenicist, and she used the black church, and those churches helped kill those twenty million babies. Brothers, we are the ones who are going to stop this, not with fancy language and not by being nice, but through the teaching of the scriptures. That is what we were sent for.

sense.text:
The black man is the most hated man in society today. They have been finding young men lynched in the woods. Be mindful of your surroundings, and stop thinking this country loves you. Some of you think we are surviving because of our good looks; we are surviving because we are the Israelites, God's chosen people, and this planet was created for us. The Bishop always said: you work with these people, but after work get in your car and go home. Don't stop at the bar for a drink, don't go to their barbecue. These people do not want you around.

Christ said, “If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.”

We are what you call pilgrims. This is not our world and not our kingdom; we were put here to learn a lesson. “But because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.” Christ chose us out of this world, and because we are a righteous, special people, we are going to be hated. Why are you surprised that nobody likes you?

The problem is that some of you are seeking love in the wrong places, doing whatever it takes to make these people love you, and they will never accept you. The biggest propaganda on social media right now is the black man against the black woman and the black woman against the black man, and Esau is behind it, to push interracial marriage. We are the only people who talk like that about each other; a white man married to an Indian or Chinese woman will never talk bad about the white woman in front of another nation. You see a black man start dating a white woman, and all of a sudden every black woman is the devil; a black woman finds one of those white trailer trash, and all of a sudden every single black man is no damn good. We put our own down to please them, to be loved by them, and they will never accept you. There is never going to be a high-value white man married to a black woman; a filthy rich white man wants children that look like him. A lot of these trailer trash you are dating, you are the one supporting them. Judgment is coming for the black man and the black woman who go against what the law says, if they do not repent.

“The servant is not greater than his lord.” We are not greater than Christ. We are the servants of Christ, so if they hurt Christ, they are going to hurt us too. Stop seeking love where there is no love.

The scripture has good news for the Israelite. “I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah”: both kingdoms, the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom. “And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.” We shall possess the land.

The white man, the enemies of Israel, have always capitalized off of our hatred. “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we”. The enemy knows that we are more and mightier than he is.
“Come on, let us deal wisely with them”: crafty counsel, putting plays together. That is called strategy, so that we would not multiply and join their enemies and get up out of the land.

“When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him”. That is what abortion has evolved into: make the babies that come out of the Israelite wombs vanish.

They were doing it by proxy, through the midwives, hoping the midwives felt like the rebellious Israelites felt coming out of Egypt, we miss the garlic, we miss the leeks, take us back, we like being slaves. They were hoping the midwives loved their enemy and hated themselves.

“But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.” That means the midwives loved their people: they feared God, and the way they showed it was by loving their people.

Now the black mind has been twisted and perverted so that they don't even have to put out an edict to kill the children. The black woman will do it herself, by the millions, and that is a genocide in itself. So we must be the ones to correct this, to set the nation back in order: restore the love of ourselves and the fear of God, and show that the enemy hates us.

“Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them”. The prophecy is that we were scattered. “And I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely”: the Most High God is going to bring us back to our land.

precepts.why:
This hatred is not going to go on forever. Whatever we are going through, the Most High God is going to bring us back again.

“For thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation”: redeemed out of every nation, where we were scattered.

sense.text:
“I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you”. From all the nations: this is for the Israelite who says there are no Israelites in Africa. No matter where you go on the planet, you are going to find Israelites.

“And I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.” That place is Israel, Jerusalem: our land. Everything you see is temporary. It is like a movie where you already know the end, and at the end you win. So why are you bugging out? Last week Bishop Yaqub was talking about how some of us turn to liquor to deal with the hatred. You have to expect the hatred. You are dying to be loved by people who are never going to love you.

precepts.why:
This is why Christ said, “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”: teach all the Israelites, because we were scattered into all nations. That is the prophecy, and no matter where we are, we are going to be hated.

That is why we travel to all these countries, to tell our people that they are the Israelites; that is why we just had one of the biggest blitzes all over the world. We understand the scripture and we follow the scripture.

Christ understood this. “And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake”. If Christ, the Black Messiah himself, said we would be hated of all men, why am I surprised when they hate me? Christians are not reading this Bible. “But he that endureth to the end shall be saved.”

When they persecute you in one city, flee to another: “for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.” We are not going to be able to wake up every single Israelite before Christ comes back.

sense.text:
“And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel”. The scripture keeps repeating it: bring them back. What you see right now is the beginning of bringing us back again. We are repenting; we read the Bible and say, wait a minute, that's us. You are watching the rise of the greatest nation, and nothing is going to stop it.

“And they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them”. We are starting to build the waste cities. Look at your life before you came here and look at it today: a whole different person, a whole 360. Some of your families hate it. Some of them loved you when you were selling drugs, smoking weed, going to the clubs; they say the new you is boring, it's all about the Bible, what's with the head wrap, why can't you wear pants to work. That shows you the Bible is a true book.

“For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries”. He keeps repeating it, because we are scattered all over the earth. “And will bring you into your own land.” I thought Haiti was my land, America was my land, Jamaica was my land. No: your own land.

“Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean”: clean from all your sin, your adulteries, your whoremongering, homosexuality and lesbianism. “And from all your idols, will I cleanse you”: Christianity, the churches, Islam.
“A new heart also will I give you”: a new mind. “And I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh”: that is the sinful heart.
“And cause you to walk in my statutes”: cause you to walk in my laws.
When you read this, brothers and sisters, it should give you hope. Whatever we are going through right now is nothing compared to what is coming to us.

“And the wastes shall be builded.” Right now that land is a waste place, because the right people, the right owners, are not in it.

“This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden”. This prophecy is also telling you that the people over there are not the real Israelites, because it has not happened yet; their land doesn't look like the garden of Eden. If they were the true Israelites, the prophet Ezekiel didn't know what he was talking about.
“I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.”
“After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts”.

“And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me”. We won't have to teach each other any more, because all of us are going to know the law. This is the Israelite, and this is talking about the kingdom.
“Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.”

“And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet”.

We cannot fathom these words right now. Who is going to bow down in front of the black man? People will look at it and say you're dreaming. But that is what the scripture says. Let God be true and every man a liar.

precepts.why: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet”. That is the bowing down: they will bow down before thy feet.

sense.text:
“Thy people also shall be all righteous”. All of us are going to be righteous. Imagine living in a society where you don't have Negroes killing each other or walking around with their pants below their butt. There will never be peace in the earth until we get rid of Esau, because every war and every destruction in the earth is caused by Esau.

There was a time we were righteous. There was a time you broke God's laws and you died, or we killed you; we did not play with the nations. That is coming back again. “They shall inherit the land for ever”.

“A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation”: he is talking about the kingdom of heaven. “I the Lord will hasten it in his time”: the kingdom of Israel is going to go fast.

So don't worry about the hatred or what you are going through here. Don't worry about Trump's billion dollars. Let them keep their money; what we have coming is greater. We are not going to ask for reparation, we are going to take it. That billion is a down payment.

The problem with the black community is not finance. We had Black Wall Street; here in Georgia we had a town where Lake Lanier is now. We had it over and over, and nothing changed; people take the money and run. There is no unity without the scriptures. Everything we did that never succeeded failed because this was not involved. This is built with the scriptures, and God is behind it, not men.

Even in misery we find a way to enjoy ourselves, and the other nations cannot stand to see us happy, at our Passover and our feasts. When we are in our righteousness, that is what they hate; when you are living foul they encourage you and pay you extra. Keep giving them something to hate. We have tried to march our way out and vote our way out; we have to come back to this book and stand on the foundation God created.

“He retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.” God does not hold his anger against us forever. Earlier we read that God does not change, and if he had changed, all of Israel would be consumed. He is still a merciful God, no matter what we do. Before you came here you did something most evil; why are you still alive? Because of God's mercy.

“He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.” He will forgive our sins and not remember them any more. We serve a merciful God; some of us should have been buried a long time ago.

precepts.why:
Some “told him of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.” Christ said, “Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?” Do you suppose these Israelites were sinners above all other Israelites because they got killed?

“I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.” That message is for us today. We will all perish too if we do not repent. Don't think you are better than the men who were before you; you are here because of God's mercy. Every day when you pray, thank the Lord for his mercy that you are still here.

sense.text:
“Gather yourselves together”: that is what we are doing right now. “O nation not desired”: nobody desires us. Chris Rock made a joke that the poorest white trailer trash wouldn't exchange places with him, and he's rich; that man is going to ride this white thing out.

We should say the same: I'm going to ride this Israelite thing out. I don't care if they have a room full of gold; this black skin, I'm going to ride it out. I don't want to trade places with Elon Musk, a billionaire, because whatever he has is temporary, and what I am about to get is eternal.

“Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” God is telling us to come together as one. It is called unity. Before he brings his judgment on the earth, come together, build ourselves up, and separate ourselves from these people.

“Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.” We are the daughter of Zion. Be glad, brothers; be glad, sisters. Rejoice in the law. Today is the Sabbath; be happy you are here with your brothers and sisters. It should be a joy when we are together.

Who cares why they hate you? You already know why: they were created to hate you. It's a good damn thing they hate you. Yes, I said it. It's a good thing they hate us, and they should continue to hate us. We love it.

“The Lord hath taken away thy judgments”. Our judgment is almost ended. We don't have a lot of time here; this is a short time. So why are you bugging out, why are you crying, why are you sad, asking why they hate me? Let them hate you; it is a good thing. “He hath cast out thine enemy”: God has cast out our enemies.

precepts.why:
“Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people”. That is the God of Israel, and the Black Messiah. “And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”: that horn of salvation is Christ.

“That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us”. Why are you worried that your enemies hate you? Your enemies are not supposed to love you; they are supposed to hate you. The problem is you think you don't have any enemies. Your enemies were created to hate you. Our people say, I don't understand, what did we do to you? This is the answer: Christ is coming back to save you from the hand of all that hate you. So don't worry about those that hate you. Rejoice.

“To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant”. The mercy promised to our forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob is that the kingdom is ours. That is the promise: we are going to get the kingdom.

sense.text: “I see a flying roll”. “This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off”.

“And it shall enter into the house of the thief”: America is the house of the thief. This place was stolen. “And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”: that is America.

“And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.” The curse is going to remain in the midst of his house. That is the judgment coming on America.

Those calling themselves Israel today try to put it in our people's minds that they were here from Genesis and have been ruling the earth since Genesis. They never mention slavery, Egypt, Babylon or Persia, as if they were all of them. Believe it or not, some of our people believe that.

precepts.why:
Esau claims to have been the first ones here. Josephus writes that the Greeks became the authors of the changes to the names the nations were given by their first founders, and that when they grew powerful they claimed the glory of antiquity for themselves, as if the nations were derived from them. They claim to be the first man, the last samurai, the last Mohican, the Egyptians, everybody. They do it because so many of our people don't read, so we won't know our true history. It is all a plot against our people.

“And thou, that hast been the author of all mischief against the Hebrews, shalt not escape the hands of God.” They have been the author of all mischief against God's people, and they are not going to escape the hands of God.

Some of you think nothing is going to happen here. “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: they always hate us. Esau has a perpetual hatred against us.

“And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword”. You are standing in a bloody land. The blood of our forefathers and foremothers was spilled all over this land, and after they did it they built churches and said come worship God. When we went to Africa, a brother on a radio show said he wanted Liberia to be like America, a democracy, and the Bishop asked him if he knew what he was saying. Think how many people America killed in the name of democracy. There is no such thing; democracy is something Esau created to control the black nations. People rise up against the government and kill people, and the president is about to pay them 1.7 billion dollars. They are still shedding our blood today: you are stupid if you believe all these young brothers and sisters found lynched killed themselves.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”. Blood is going to pursue Esau, and the judgment is about to come here. Look at the so-called Middle East: black people forget, but those people are not going to forget who they are killing right now.

“Sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” Esau, the white man, is a bloody man. They love blood; even their food they want medium rare. They love war, they love killing people, they love violence. The white man is a natural-born killer, and that is his nature; you cannot change it. When it comes to violence you cannot compare the black man with the white man. We do kiddie stuff, and we only turn our violence against each other; Esau kills a whole nation.

sense.text: “The king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.” We shall not see evil any more.
“In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not”. The Lord is going to remove all our fears.
“The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty”. The Lord is going to be in the midst of us.
“I will gather them that are sorrowful”. We are sorrowful.

“Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee”. God is going to undo all the nations that afflict us. “And I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.”

Where were we put to shame? In America, in Haiti, in Jamaica. All our lives we have been put to shame. But God says he will give us praise and fame. The people are going to know who you are; they will know your name, your children, and your children's names. You haven't seen fame yet.

“For I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.” Among all nations: those same nations who hate us today, the same ones you are asking, why do you hate me? God says he is going to make us a praise among them. Twelve tribes, worldwide.
